AI Engineer Job Description:


AI Basics
Understand AI landscape
Basic understanding of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Gen AI and Agentic AI.

Gen AI and Agentic AI
LLM
Vector databases, Embeddings
RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
Frameworks

Python programming language for AI
Variables, Numbers, Strings
Lists, Dictionaries, Sets, Tuples
If condition, for loop
Functions, Lambda Functions
Classes, Objects
Modules (pip install)
Read, Write files
Exception handling
Inheritance, Generators, Iterators
List Comprehensions, Decorators
Multithreading, Multiprocessing

Data Structures and Algorithms
Data structures basics
Data structures: Arrays, Hash Table, Linked List, Stack, Queue, Tree, Graph
Algorithms: Binary search, Bubble sort
Recursion

Version Control (Git, Github, Gitlab)
Basic commands: add, commit, push.
Branches, reverting change, HEAD, Diff and Merge
Pull requests.

SQL
Basics of relational databases.
Basic Queries: SELECT, WHERE LIKE, DISTINCT, BETWEEN, GROUP BY, ORDER BY
Joins: Left, Right, Inner, Full

DevOps, ML Ops, FastAPI

Good to have:
Cloud Servcies (GCP, Azure, AWS) (any one)
Math and Statistics for AI
Machine Learning: Preprocessing and Model Building
Computer Vision
